question: How should conventional Windows/Fluent software verbs sit inside the selected static APP VISUAL system without redrawing platform meaning, spreading accent color, or turning MAT/STA mechanisms into decorative icon chrome?
glyph_source: Segoe Fluent Icons with Segoe MDL2 Assets fallback; conventional symbol meaning only.
prohibited: No Threshold K, app-icon or wordmark geometry reused as interface icon anatomy.
No default teal icon color or semantic status color.
No motion as a scored differentiator.

CNEG.name: Persistent Filled Tile
CNEG.treatment: Every icon sits in a persistent soft-surface square tile.

F1.name: Native Quiet Carrier
F1.treatment: Platform glyph uses currentColor on a visually quiet/transparent carrier at rest; structural focus appears only when focused; labels remain available where context requires.

F2.name: Persistent Boundary Button
F2.treatment: Platform glyph sits in a persistent thin-boundary control box even at rest.

F3.name: Material Channel Hook
F3.treatment: Platform glyph is attached to a subtractive MAT edge/channel witness as its default visual carrier.

required_checks: Every icon-only control has an accessible name.
Conventional glyph source is locally available or the case is invalid.
Focus-visible remains a structural ring independent from icon color.
CurrentColor glyphs remain legible in Light, Dark and forced-colors.
At-rest conventional verbs do not require accent color.
Labeled examples remain readable at 200% text and text-spacing stress.

subjective_falsification: Treatment redraws or obscures a familiar platform verb instead of preserving native meaning.
Icon chrome becomes more visually authoritative than the task/content.
Every icon begins to read as a card/tile or dashboard widget.
MAT subtractive topology is reduced to a decorative icon badge.
Teal spreads into default icon color or semantic status meaning.
Focus and selection become inseparable from icon treatment.
Treatment resembles Threshold K/app-icon anatomy strongly enough to create a second mark.
Light and Dark no longer read as the same icon system.
next_gate: Materialize CNEG/F1/F2/F3 with the same conventional Fluent verbs in selected Light F2 and Dark D3, run the complete mechanical/accessibility matrix, then perform subjective falsification on normal-color wide and narrow evidence.
